scientific_integrity: Integral claims follow from a nerve and Mayer-Vietoris proof with an explicit unimodular component map; mod-two face enumeration is corroborative only. Priority is subject to finite literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Homology classification for n>=5 only; no homotopy equivalence, fundamental-group classification, or low-degree symmetry character. Finite computations do not prove uniform or integral assertions.
title: Complete integral homology of three-row rook neighborhood complexes
